frozen_prompts.source: Independently materialized by the R1 verifier from frozen R1 rendering and canonical EXP29-V02.

normalization.jsonl_record_order: One-based physical line ordinal after requiring every non-empty line to parse as exactly one JSON value; arrays and records are never reordered.
normalization.session_id: Copy the unique thread.started.thread_id; absent or inconsistent identity is Unknown and stops the arm.
normalization.event_id: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8(thread_id) concatenated with one NUL byte and UTF-8(item.id).
normalization.arm_id: Copy from the sealed per-arm invocation envelope and record invocation_sha256 as provenance.
normalization.start_sequence: One-based JSONL line ordinal of the matching lifecycle start record when publicly emitted.
normalization.finish_sequence: One-based JSONL line ordinal of the matching lifecycle completion record.
normalization.optional_wall_clock_timestamps: Copy exact public value if present; otherwise Unknown. Never synthesize.
normalization.canonical_json: UTF-8 RFC8259 JSON; object keys recursively sorted lexicographically, arrays preserved, no insignificant whitespace, Unicode unescaped.
normalization.mcp_request_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for raw item.arguments.
normalization.mcp_response_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for raw completed item.result.
normalization.web_request_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the raw WebSearchCallResponseItem.action object.
normalization.web_response_sha256: Hash only an explicitly emitted raw response payload. If none is emitted, record Unknown; never hash a locator, status or invented body as response.

accepted_web_event.identity_rule: Require non-empty id and non-null supported action; search requires at least one non-empty query/query entry, while open_page and find_in_page require non-empty url.
accepted_web_event.runtime_mismatch: Unknown transport observability, arm cannot be validated, stop without replacement.

sequence_precedence.treatment_rule: The completed lifecycle line for the sole bateia_recommend must have finish_sequence strictly less than the first observable native web line.
sequence_precedence.first_web_observable_sequence: Minimum of web start_sequence when present, otherwise its finish_sequence.

capabilities.treatment: native web plus exactly one bateia_recommend from the sole required Bateia server

evidence_and_unknown.locator: Use action.url when present or a direct locator from final output evidence_references; never invent.
evidence_and_unknown.missing_web_response_body_or_hash: Record Unknown without manufacturing bytes. This alone does not invalidate an otherwise observable web action.
evidence_and_unknown.missing_web_id_action_or_required_query_: Fail closed as unobservable arm and stop without replacement.
evidence_and_unknown.inconclusive: Neutral abstention, neither automatic defeat nor success.
evidence_and_unknown.catalysis: Count only an observable Bateia direction followed by a later web action and a useful supported confirmation, rejection or narrowing reflected in the final output.

evaluation.phase_1: Blind final-output judgment with arm mapping and traces hidden; freeze receipt hash before reveal.
evaluation.phase_2: Post-reveal catalysis audit over frozen blind receipt and normalized ordered trace.
evaluation.winner_policy: Unchanged: treatment uplift requires blind preference for treatment plus at least one proven catalytic path; otherwise do not force a winner.
evaluation.live_web_drift: Unknown confounding unless resolved; never automatic equality or arm effect.

unknown_policy: Unknown never becomes Preserved, Violated, success, loss, tie, zero or retry by default. Operationally, an Unknown required for arm identity, ordering or validity blocks the pair; optional absent timestamps and response bodies remain explicitly Unknown without invention.
